sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)

literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1–L3, PMC2719720) describe the same construct: mCx23 fused to eGFP at the C-terminus. The authoritative topology places the C-terminus (residues 197–205) in the intracellular compartment, so this insertion does not qualify as a surface tag site. The N-terminus (residues 1–24) is likewise intracellular. No ledger line describes any insertion in ECL1 (44–74) or ECL2 (139–170), the only extracellular loops. The paper confirms plasma-membrane insertion of the full-length protein but does not report any extracellular-face tagging. Zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: mCx23-eGFP C-terminal fusion expressed in HeLa cells; the C-terminus (residues 197–205) is intracellular per topology, so this tag is cytoplasmic, not on the extracellular face.
